Definition: middle voice from G833; to pass the night (properly, in the open air):--abide, lodge.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus went out of the city to Bethany and lodged there, and Luke says He spent the days teaching in the temple and the nights lodging on the Mount of Olives. The word means to spend the night in the open, to abide.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the nights on the mountain were the quiet half of His last week, and the city that would not receive Him by day could not keep Him by night.
